releasePurpose: Publish the approved source-limited domestic and family violence research summaries to staging and make them retrievable by Universal One.
classificationPolicy: All 117 mapped to applicable canonical filters. Missing ages remain unspecified; no gene or molecular-target measurements inferred; possible age eligibility is not enrolled population evidence; DV shelter membership alone is not homelessness.

communitySearchCounts.note: Whole-library search also includes earlier research. Primary collection labels and clinical efficacy are separate.

paperCrosses: The approved papers show one cross for a randomized trial, two only for verified double blinding, none for other designs. Underlying numeric library scores retain their established schema; filter labels state the design criteria.
approvalMeaning: AI assessed; human approved for publication. No human clinical peer review is claimed. The frozen audit is unchanged.
universalOne: Versioned approved-record retrieval deployed with the staging worker. Existing database results are deduplicated against approved IDs, aliases and DOIs. No database mutations, fine-tuning, batch embeddings or third-party full-text uploads.
